subject: CS476
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos. For English, all topics are covered with high-quality, relevant videos from authoritative sources like Martin Kleppmann and Jim Kurose. For Arabic, coverage is good for most topics, with strong practical tutorials on Sockets and Message Brokers. The topic 'Transient vs Persistent Communication' in Arabic had no candidates that met the minimum view count, resulting in an empty slot.

coverage.note: All relevant candidates failed the view count gate (< 3000 views).
